The '''Vertica''' was a [[repulsorcraft]] platform produced by [[Vectron]] during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].

==Behind the scenes==
The Vectron Vertica was first added to the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as one of the items in the Disavowed Alliance Pack.
